verdict.rationale: Solid documents Resources for loading server data as reactive state with Suspense, plus full SSR with streaming and progressive hydration and isomorphic rendering. Together these let server-fetched data reach interactive components on the client. However, the evidence never shows a distinct async server-component model where server-only components fetch data and pass props down to separate client components. Data flow instead happens through isomorphic components and hydration, and one user's advice to avoid Suspense lowers confidence. Missing for 10: an async server-component / client-component boundary, documented serialization of server-fetched data passed as props to client components, and independent hands-on corroboration of the SSR data-fetching flow.
